value.title: Routing table
value.summary: Roadmap 001 s08: pij builds a routing table from every role's scope, warns on overlaps, writes community/ROUTES.md, and sends it to a seat on assign, after a compact, on revive and on demand; changed rows go as one FYI to the prime.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Delivers req-11; builds c-routes. A change of holder sends nothing. The hand-written ROUTES.md in the governance community folder is replaced by the generated one (adopt-style: the first generation overwrites it in a writer commit, with the old text kept in the commit history).

sections.name: goals
value: Roadmap 001 s08: pij builds a routing table from every role's scope, warns on overlaps, writes community/ROUTES.md, and sends it to a seat on assign, after a compact, on revive and on demand; changed rows go as one FYI to the prime.

sections.name: non_goals
value: Anything another roadmap step owns; see roadmap 001.

value.claim: Build and write. From every role's scope (paths and rules) pij generates `community/ROUTES.md` through the writer on any role add or scope change, and warns on two roles claiming one path.
Deliver. The table reaches a seat when it is assigned to a role, after it is compacted, when a revived seat returns, and on demand (`pij directory routes`).
Notify. When routes change, the changed rows go as one FYI to the prime only; reassigning a holder sends nothing.
Cost (AGENTS.md, resource cost is a correctness property). One writer commit per regeneration; one delivery per trigger. No timer or poll.

Docs and states. In this PR: roadmap s08 goes to complete (plan cell docs/plans/202-routing-table); req-11 goes to shipped; c-routes goes to shipped. docs/how/pij-rs-api.md documents new verbs and refusals; the skill's verb coverage tables carry them; `just ddocs-check` and `ddocs validate` on the project docs pass; the PR body has a `Delivers:` line.

sections.name: research_context
sections.value: Code to read first: crates/daemon/src/community/ (role documents, writer, the after-assign hook), the compact and revive paths. No migration expected.

value.risk: Two lanes edit the same CLI wiring or skill files.
value.mitigation: Rebase onto main before the PR; small diffs at the seam; pm-001 orders merges.

sections.name: execution_guardrails
value: Tests use scratch repos and a private daemon; never the live governance branch or the prod daemon.
Builds: your own target or `just shared-build`; CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0; -p scoping; stop under 25 GB free.
No `git add -A`, no `--no-verify`; no node_modules, never symlinked (C25); TS proof is CI on the exact head.
Shared seams (crates/cli wiring, skills/pij): rebase onto main before the PR and keep edits minimal; don't fork the seam.
One push per review round; no pushes after the PR is out for verdicts unless a verdict asks.
